en-US: Improved enhanced voice loading, continuous playback and stop response. Fixed Volcengine Agent Plan speech and added configurable OpenAI-compatible speech addresses. Office printing and PDF export now share an upper-right entry, automatic previews and a handwriting option. Improved Excel gridlines, ranges and scaling, and added Word and PowerPoint paper and scaling controls. Search provider names now follow catalog updates while preserving custom names. Fixed skill update feedback and the synced-device list. Please try first and repeated voice playback, stopping and switching voices, and Office print previews with and without handwriting.
zh-Hans: 改善增强语音的加载、连续播放和停止响应；修复火山引擎 Agent Plan 语音，支持配置 OpenAI 兼容语音服务地址。Office 打印与 PDF 导出集中到右上角，自动更新预览，可选择是否包含笔迹；改进 Excel 网格线、打印范围与缩放，补充 Word 和 PPT 的纸张及打印缩放设置。搜索供应商名称随目录自动更新，保留自行修改的名称。修复技能更新提示和同步设备列表。请重点体验首次及重复播放、停止与切换音色，以及包含／不包含笔迹的 Office 打印预览。
